title: [S2] `_bury`'s files write has no lease guard — a zombie can plant a failure reason on a file the winner publishes

base.why: no unlanded dependency exists — 0 open PRs and origin has only refs/heads/main, so origin/main is forced, not chosen

not_already_solved_on_main.how: evidence/issue_86_zombie_bury_repro.py reproduced FINAL: status='ready' failed_reason='unparseable' chunks=1 against origin/main @ 8d641b3

needs_nate.q: Add the invariant 'a ready file carries no failure reason' to design/components/ingestion-worker.md? The issue names it; the spec is silent; the code will enforce it from both sides. This is spec authorship outside the ticket's footprint.
needs_nate.answer: yes — add the invariant to design/components/ingestion-worker.md

delegated.q: guard shape: the issue's EXISTS(state='processing' AND lease_token=...) vs leased_until > now()
delegated.decided: EXISTS, verbatim from the issue - it is `_settle`'s two conditions, so both halves of `_bury` agree about ownership. `leased_until > now()` was rejected by mutation, not argument: it strands a file whose ingest outran its lease. See .ship/86/decisions.md D1.

delegated.q: does the reproduction ship as a test, or as a script under evidence/
delegated.decided: BOTH - the test is what CI runs and what the guard-deletion mutant kills; the script narrates the five-step interleaving and outlives the worktree. See decisions.md D2.

delegated.q: test placement: extend tests/gct/jobs/test_worker.py or a new module
delegated.decided: extend tests/gct/jobs/test_worker.py, new titled section at the end - same shape as the #82 and #24 sections, and it reuses that module's local fixtures. See decisions.md D3.

delegated.q: _bury's docstring names #86 as an open residual and goes stale on this fix — rewrite scope
delegated.decided: four sites, not one: `_bury`'s guard paragraphs, `process_one`'s WHAT IT DOES NOT CLOSE block, the module docstring's jobs-ownership line, and one test docstring. Census: grep -rn '#86' src/ tests/ design/ scripts/. See decisions.md D4.

delegated.q: pin the guard-shape edge (an ingest outrunning its lease with no reaper) with its own test
delegated.when: after the primary test is green
delegated.decided: yes - and a second one for the `state='processing'` half. Three tests, four mutations run, each red on exactly one test. See decisions.md D5.

verify.derivation: derive_guards.py, adapted: code_view blanks every string literal, so it derived ZERO guards on this SQL-in-a-string diff. It now leaves a literal visible when the literal's own first word is select|update|insert|delete|with, plus five SQL decision tokens (where/exists/from/<>/=). Both changes mechanical; adapted copy kept at .ship/86/mutations/derive_guards.py.
verify.mutations: 10 run, 8 RED / 2 GREEN. 6 cover the derived obligation (5/5 guards covered, mutate86.py's coverage assertion passed); 4 are declared beyond it.

surviving_mutants.0004: job_id dropped from the EXISTS - settled by differential search over 338 exhaustively enumerated jobs-table states: distinguishable in principle (needs a second `processing` row with the same lease_token, which no schema constraint forbids), unreachable in practice (lease_token is written by exactly two statements, one of which is gen_random_uuid()). No test added, and none is missing.
surviving_mutants.0007: select 1 -> select 0. Equivalence CONTROL, not a finding.
